Maya R.: Heads-up — I need to swap part of my primary shift on Thu (18:00->02:00 UTC). Flight moved to 19:15 so I won't be reliably online after 18:30. Can someone cover primary from 18:00->00:00 or take the whole window? We had a low-sev embeds latency pager earlier (14:10 UTC) that was resolved by a cache flush; leaving runbook notes below for whoever picks this up.

Arjun P.: I can cover 18:00->00:00. Happy to shadow until 20:00 for context, then take full primary. @Maya R. can you paste the quick handoff checklist? :thumbsup:

Liam: I can pick up 00:00->02:00. If @Arjun P. wants to hand over at midnight we can do a 15m overlap (00:00-00:15) to run through traces. I'll set a reminder.

Maya R.: Thanks @Arjun P. and @Liam. Quick handoff checklist (short):
1) Active incidents: none open; recent pager at 14:10 for embeddings latency (resolved).
2) Telemetry pointers: dashboards -> Observability / Embeds / Latency (last 24h).
3) Runbook excerpt for embeds latency (paste):
```
If embeddings latency > 1200ms over 5m:
 - `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embeds-producer`
 - `kubectl logs -n inference <pod> --since=5m | grep WARN`
 - If kv_cache_miss_rate > 0.05, run cache reset: `redwoodctl cache flush --service embeds`
 - If error spike persists, escalate to infra-team and switch routing to medium model: `redwoodctl route set --model medium --reason handoff`
```
4) Tokens/overrides: I left the emergency override tokens in 1Password entry "oncall/overrides"; team has readonly.
5) Contacts: my flight contact +1-555-0112 (SMS), but I'll try to respond to urgent pages until airborne.

oncall-bot: Rotation updated: Maya R. -> Arjun P. (primary 18:00-00:00 UTC), Liam (primary 00:00-02:00 UTC). Pager routing unchanged. Link: https://redwood.internal/oncall/schedule#week

oncall-bot: Reminder posted: shadow overlap requested 00:00-00:15 UTC.

Sophie: Quick note on telemetry: I pulled the span traces for the 14:07-14:15 window — tail latency appeared to correlate with a burst of KV misses from the new embed shard (shard-3). If it returns, check Prometheus: `kv_cache_miss_rate{shard="shard-3"}` and the embed-producer logs for `timeout writing kv`.

Arjun P.: Thanks for the details @Maya R. and @Sophie. I'll take primary at 18:00 and monitor the embeddings dashboard for 30m. If latency > 2kms I'll trigger routing fallback (`redwoodctl route set --model medium --reason handoff`) and post status here.

Liam: I'll shoot a post at 23:50 UTC to confirm handover and call out any open items. If anyone needs to reach me urgently during my window, DM me or call my number in the oncall roster.

Maya R.: Appreciate it all. Leaving one last note: if you see a repeat of the kv timeout errors, try a graceful restart of embed-producer on the offending node first (scale down -> up) rather than immediate redeploy — that preserves warm caches.

Arjun P.: Copy that. I'll leave a quick status post at 18:30 and update if anything pops. Good luck and safe travels @Maya R.! :airplane:

Liam: :thumbsup:
